content: नियत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Curbed, restrained; तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया <ls>Bg. 7. 20</ls>. .²2 Subdued, controlled, self-possessed, self-governed. .²3 Abstemious, temperate. .²4 Attentive, intent. .²5 Fixed, permanent, constant, steady; अन्यथासिद्धिशून्यस्य नियता पूर्ववर्तिता <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls> .²6 .³({%a%}) Certain, settled, sure; <ls>Pt. 1. 284</ls>. .³({%b%}) Fixed; प्रकृतिनियतत्वादकृतकः <ls>U. 6. 14</ls>; fixed in number, limited; बाणाः पञ्च मनोभवस्य नियतास्तेषामसंख्यो जनः (लक्ष्यः) <ls>Ratn. 3. 3</ls>. .²7 Inevitable. .²8 Positive, definite. .²9 Forming the subject of consideration, relevant or irrelevant; see तुल्ययोगिता. .²10 Maintained, observed (as a vow <ab>&c.</ab>); नियतैकपतिव्रतानि पश्चात्तरुमूलानि गृहीभवन्ति तेषाम् <ls>Ś. 7. 20</ls>. .²11 Held back, fastened, tied; पशूनां त्रिशतं तत्र यूपेषु नियतं तदा <ls>Rām. 1. 14. 32</ls>. .²12 Connected with, dependent on; वाच्यर्था नियताः सर्वे <ls>Ms. 4. 256</ls>. .²13 (in <ab>gram.</ab>) Pronounced with अनुदात्त. .{@-तम्@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) (in Sāṅkhya) the organs of sense. .{@-तम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Always, constantly. .²2 Positively, certainly, invariably, inevitably, surely. .²3 Forcibly.
